artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan across 7 dependency waves; 6.5h estimated (5.75h if the conditional unstable-marker phase is not entered).

key_findings: Planning-time finding absent from the research report: commit f9cc081e (task 153 phase 4, 2026-08-31 13:35) added build_seriality_constraint and build_interpolation_constraint to build_frame_constraints, wired immediately before skolem_abundance. The spawn analysis ruled out tasks 152/158/175 but never checked 153.

Timeline correction: the 2/2 observed failures were recorded at c8821e96 (12:05) and the spawn landed at 3224df24 (12:14), both BEFORE f9cc081e (13:35). Seriality/Interpolation cannot be the original cause, but is a live confound at HEAD, so Phase 1 must re-classify at HEAD rather than inherit the pre-153 characterization.

f9cc081e's own commit message independently records 'a pre-existing MBQI pathology in capped_skolem_abundance_constraint's bare-satisfiability check at M=3, confirmed present pre-Phase-4 too' -- an independent sighting of this task's exact symptom class -- plus a genuine BM_CM_4 cost regression (4.07s decided -> inconclusive at 120s) that is superlinear in the combination of the two new axioms.

The test is NOT covered by task 173's development marker (oracle/ has no development marker), so it is still selected by run-oracle-suite.sh pass 1. It also carries no xdist_serial marker, so it runs in the parallel -n 6 pass.

Task 126 phase 21 (a404edbd) renamed bimodal/semantic.py to bimodal/semantic/core.py, so a path-stable diff against the post-114 baseline (12eb4ded) fails; the plan specifies `git show 12eb4ded:code/src/model_checker/theory_lib/bimodal/semantic.py`.
z3-solver version drift is an axis git bisection structurally cannot reach; the plan gives it a dedicated isolated-venv sweep phase with a mandatory control run.
blocking_conditions: Phase 6 (unstable marking) is forbidden if Phase 1/4 classify the failure as a genuine unsat -- TESTING_GUIDE 8.9 criterion 2 cannot be met for a changed logical conclusion. In that case the task terminates [BLOCKED] and escalates rather than quarantining a semantic defect.
